input:
* I want to remove the icon for creating a snippet from selected text. This icon is located in the Runner modal, to the right of the “X” icon used to close the Runner.

* I want to update the sections about “Existing Canvas Protocols” and “Snippets” in the README files. The old Canvas protocols are no longer used anywhere, so this information is only confusing. The same applies to snippets: we now use only `.md` snippets, which can contain placeholders or plain text. We no longer use the JSON format.

* I want to remove the “Text block” node type and have the “Answer” node perform the same function. For example, in a sequence such as `Question → Answer1 → Answer2`, the user selects `Answer1` because it comes directly after the `Question`, while `Answer2` is inserted automatically, similar to how the “Text block” node currently works. The goal is to reduce the number of node types to the minimum necessary and avoid having nodes with very similar or nearly duplicate functionality.

* I would like to discuss whether it is possible to find a good solution for the following task: I want to remove the “Loop” node type and move its functionality to the “Question” node. For example, there could be a checkbox or icon that turns a regular “Question” node into a looping question that allows the user to select multiple answers, similar to how the current “Loop” node works. It is important that configuring and using such nodes remains convenient and intuitive for the user.

* I want newly created protocols to include a “Start” node by default, so that users do not have to create it manually immediately after creating a protocol and can start building connections from it right away.

* I want the selected snippet in the modal opened by the `Insert Snippet` command to be highlighted more clearly. The current highlight color is too pale, so it is not always easy to see which snippet is selected when navigating with the keyboard arrow keys.

* I want to add a small margin between the top edge of the screen and the modal opened by the `Insert Snippet` command. Currently, the modal is positioned directly against the top edge of the screen, which is not very convenient. The modal could also be extended vertically toward the bottom of the screen, while leaving a small margin at the bottom. At the moment, it only occupies approximately half of the screen height.

phases.title: Remove JSON snippet code support and rewrite README

data.summary: Removes JsonSnippet from the Snippet discriminated union and every code path that routes on it (snippet-model/service, insert/inline-runner/manager/editor/fill-in views, chip editor, runner snippet picker, tree picker, i18n), making .md the sole snippet format (plain MdSnippet + front-matter MdTemplateSnippet). Existing .json files silently stop loading (listFolder skips them, load returns null); no migration tooling. Rewrites README.md and README.ru.md to drop stale Canvas sections, the phantom 'Convert Canvas protocol to .rp.json' command, the intro .canvas clause, and corrects the placeholder type list to 'free text or choice' while documenting the two .md snippet formats. MdTemplateSnippet becomes the sole placeholder-bearing variant and renderMdTemplateSnippet the sole render engine.
exports: src/snippets/snippet-model.ts:Snippet — narrowed union `MdSnippet | MdTemplateSnippet`; JsonSnippet/SnippetFile/renderSnippet removed; downstream consumers must no longer branch on kind === 'json'
src/snippets/snippet-model.ts:renderMdTemplateSnippet — unchanged signature, now the sole snippet render engine (replaces renderSnippet at the fill-in/preview path)

src/snippets/snippet-service.ts:SnippetService.listFolder/load/save — listFolder skips .json entries; load('.json') returns null; save accepts only MdSnippet|MdTemplateSnippet; duplicateSnippet deep-copies placeholders only for md-template; renameSnippet extension fixed to .md; sanitizeJson removed
src/views/snippet-fill-in-modal.ts:SnippetFillInModal — constructor narrows to `MdTemplateSnippet`; uses renderMdTemplateSnippet exclusively
src/views/snippet-chip-editor.ts:EditableTemplateSnippet — narrowed to MdTemplateSnippet; mountChipEditor draft is MdTemplateSnippet
src/views/snippet-editor-modal.ts:DraftKind — narrowed to `'md' | 'md-template'`; computeCandidatePath extension fixed to .md
src/views/snippet-manager/tree-renderer.ts:TreeNodeFile.snippetKind — narrowed to `'md' | 'md-template'`; iconForNode always `file-text` for files
src/i18n/locales/en.json + ru.json — `insertSnippet.cannotBeUsed` and `inlineRunner.snippetCannotBeUsed` keys removed; canvasParser.* keys retained (out of scope)

risks.claim: Silently dropping .json snippet files (no notice, no converter) is the agreed migration policy; user-vault .json snippets become invisible/unusable with no user-visible signal. Grade/validate should confirm no in-repo .json fixtures or e2e paths rely on json loading, and that the not-found render path (renderSnippetFillNotFound) is acceptable UX for legacy references.

renameSnippet hardcoding extension to .md is safe because load() returns null for non-.md after this slice, so no non-.md snippet is reachable through the manager to be renamed; but any hypothetical non-.md snippet file is silently renamed to .md. Validate should rule this is acceptable given the narrowed Snippet union.

Slice 1 (create-snippet-from-selection footer removal) and this slice are independent — Slice 1 removes `protocolRunner.createSnippetFromSelection` and the SnippetEditorModal import from inline-runner-modal.ts; this slice does not touch those. The two slices can land in either order with no cross-edits. Validate should confirm no file is edited by both slices in conflicting ways.

phases.title: Default a Start node into newly created protocols

data.summary: Seeds one Start ProtocolNodeRecord into createEmptyProtocolDocument() so every newly created protocol validates immediately (no noStartNode) and renders a visible node at the surface center on first open. Adds an optional startNodeId parameter (defaulting to a node-<timestamp>-<rand> id built from the already-injected clock) so the sole caller ProtocolDocumentStore.create keeps its signature while tests/imports can pass a deterministic id. The Start color and node dimensions are inlined as literals in the pure protocol layer with comments cross-referencing the view-layer constants, preserving the architecture boundary. Only protocol-document.ts and the two ProtocolDocumentStore create tests change; the store, main.ts, editor view, and validator are untouched.
exports: src/protocol/protocol-document.ts:createEmptyProtocolDocument — extended signature: new optional 4th parameter `startNodeId` (default `node-${now.getTime()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`); return now carries nodes: [one Start ProtocolNodeRecord] instead of nodes: []. The sole caller src/protocol/protocol-document-store.ts:95 (create) inherits the change unchanged via the default; any future caller may pass an explicit id for determinism.

src/protocol/protocol-document.ts — the seeded Start node record shape (kind:'start', x:0, y:0, width:200, height:80, color:'rgba(76, 175, 80, 0.28)', fields:{}) is the contract other layers consume; the color/dimensions are literals cross-referenced to src/views/protocol-editor-view.ts:248 (NODE_KIND_DEFAULTS.start) and :17-18 (DEFAULT_NODE_WIDTH/DEFAULT_NODE_HEIGHT) by comment, NOT by import — a drift hazard if those view-layer constants change.

risks.claim: The Start node color and dimensions are inlined as literals in the pure protocol layer (no import of the view-layer constants) to preserve the architecture boundary. If NODE_KIND_DEFAULTS.start.color or DEFAULT_NODE_WIDTH/DEFAULT_NODE_HEIGHT in src/views/protocol-editor-view.ts change, the seeded node drifts from the user-created-node shape with no compile-time signal. Grade/validate should rule on whether inlining-with-comment (the design's choice) is acceptable versus promoting the values to a shared constant the protocol layer may import.

The design and research assert that no other test or call site depends on createEmptyProtocolDocument returning nodes: [] (the research: 'No dedicated createEmptyProtocolDocument test file exists' and 'Other test fixtures construct ProtocolDocumentV1 directly with nodes: []'). The change flips nodes from [] to a 1-element array, so any hidden assertion of empty nodes would break. Validate should grep the repo for every createEmptyProtocolDocument reference and confirm none asserts nodes.length === 0 or nodes deep-equals [].

data.summary: CSS-only slice confined to src/styles/snippet-tree-picker.css. (a) Replaces the keyboard-highlight row background (--background-modifier-hover, identical to mouse hover) with --background-modifier-active-hover plus a 2px left accent stripe in --interactive-accent, mirroring the [data-editing=true] active-row pattern in snippet-manager.css:214-217, and adds a scoped font-weight bump on the row title. (b) Adds a deliberate top margin, a viewport-relative max-height safety cap, and raises the fixed drill-view body (360->480px) and bare search-result list (320->440px, min==max) heights so the Insert Snippet modal extends downward while preserving the slice-3 per-keystroke pinning invariant. Now declares background: var(--background-modifier-active-hover) + border-left: 2px solid var(--interactive-accent). Sibling clusters editing the picker CSS must keep this rule distinct from mouse-hover (--background-modifier-hover stays on .rp-stp-crumb:hover / .rp-stp-up-btn:hover / .radi-snippet-tree-row:hover) and must not re-introduce the old shared background token.

src/styles/snippet-tree-picker.css:.rp-insert-snippet-modal — the insert-modal container rule. Now carries align-self: flex-start (preserved from slice 3), margin-top: var(--size-4-6), and max-height: calc(100vh - var(--size-4-12)). Other clusters must not remove align-self: flex-start (it is the per-keystroke pinning invariant from slice 3) and must not widen these overrides beyond the insert-modal host scope.

src/styles/snippet-tree-picker.css:.rp-insert-snippet-picker-host .rp-stp-root > .rp-stp-body / .rp-stp-list — the host-scoped height overrides (body 480px; bare list min==max==440px). risks.claim: Raising the body to 480px and the bare list to 440px (both +120px) preserves the original ~40px delta between drill view and search view, and the max-height: calc(100vh - var(--size-4-12)) cap keeps the modal from overflowing any viewport taller than ~540px — so the taller modal does not regress the slice-3 pinning/no-jump invariant or collide with short viewports.

The new 2px --interactive-accent left stripe on .rp-stp-row-highlighted stays visually distinct from the solid-accent .rp-stp-select-folder-btn.is-committed (:283-293) and does not shift row content noticeably (no padding adjustment, matching the [data-editing=true] precedent at snippet-manager.css:214-217 which also makes none).

Silently dropping legacy .json snippet files without migration or notice is acceptable, including the existing not-found UX for protocol references to those files.

No caller or test outside the updated create tests depends on createEmptyProtocolDocument returning an empty nodes array.
The 480px body, 440px fixed search-list height, and viewport cap preserve modal pinning and scrolling on both tall and short viewports.
